paras.text: Under this system countless traders decide to produce goods on their own; therefore the work of producing goods does not take place under any regular plan, the result of which is that sometimes the production becomes more than the total purchasing power or demand of people, and the stock lies unsold (Unsold). paras.text: Socialist system (Socialism)
paras.urdu: اشتراکی نظام (Socialism)
paras.pashto: سوسیالیستي نظام (Socialism)

paras.text: The definition (Definition) of socialism has been given thus:
paras.urdu: سوشلزم (اشتراکیت) کی تعریف (Definition) یوں کی گئی ہے:
paras.pashto: د سوسیالیزم تعریف (Definition) داسې شوی:

paras.text: “By it is meant such a movement whose purpose is that all nature-made and man-made capital goods (which are used for producing things on a large scale) be given, instead of to individuals, into the custody of the nation collectively for ownership and management, so that the increasing national income can be distributed equally; but in this connection no blow should fall on the economic motive of the individual or his occupational freedom and on choice and liking in connection with consuming goods.”

paras.text: Another economist writes that in the requirements of socialism this is included, that all big industries and lands be in government or collective ownership, and they be used, instead of earning profits personally, for the joint benefit and welfare (and this work be performed exactly according to a plan at the national level). It is also called a centrally controlled economy (Centrally Controlled Economy).

paras.text: 1. Productive resources in collective ownership
paras.urdu: 1۔ پیداواری ذرائع، اجتماعی ملکیت میں:
paras.pashto: ۱. تولیدي سرچینې په ټولیز ملکیت کې

paras.text: Under this system big productive sources and instruments of production, e.g. factories, industries, businesses, railways and other economic resources etc., are taken out of private ownership and taken into national custody; as it were, the government alone is their owner; they are used under its authority; the government provides employment to every citizen; and the profits obtained from all these factories and businesses go into the government treasury, from where they are used for the benefit of the whole nation.

paras.text: 2. Equal opportunities of progress (Equal Opportunities)

paras.text: Under socialism every person is provided equal opportunities to progress in life, i.e. every young person, according to his mental inclination and natural tendencies, is provided full facilities of education and training, so that, taking full benefit from his latent abilities and mental capacities, he can adopt whatever profession he wants according to his liking and taste.

1. Productive resources in collective ownership

3. Economic development (Economic Growth)

Under socialism the pace of economic development becomes fast, because, the resources of production being in government custody, effective planning … (continued on p.287)

Sometimes a few factory owners, combining together, establish a very big business institution and give it the form of a monopoly (Monopoly), and in this way the balance of the business world is disturbed.

4. Economic ups and downs and instability

Under this system countless traders decide to produce goods on their own; therefore the work of producing goods does not take place under any regular plan, the result of which is that sometimes the production becomes more than the total purchasing power or demand of people, and the stock lies unsold (Unsold). Thus prices fall, “unemployment” begins to spread, and the economy becomes a victim of crisis (Crisis) and “recession”.

Socialist system (Socialism)

The definition (Definition) of socialism has been given thus:

“By it is meant such a movement whose purpose is that all nature-made and man-made capital goods (which are used for producing things on a large scale) be given, instead of to individuals, into the custody of the nation collectively for ownership and management, so that the increasing national income can be distributed equally; but in this connection no blow should fall on the economic motive of the individual or his occupational freedom and on choice and liking in connection with consuming goods.”

Another economist writes that in the requirements of socialism this is included, that all big industries and lands be in government or collective ownership, and they be used, instead of earning profits personally, for the joint benefit and welfare (and this work be performed exactly according to a plan at the national level). It is also called a centrally controlled economy (Centrally Controlled Economy).

The prominent characteristics of the socialist economic system are as follows:

1. Productive resources in collective ownership

Under this system big productive sources and instruments of production, e.g. factories, industries, businesses, railways and other economic resources etc., are taken out of private ownership and taken into national custody; as it were, the government alone is their owner; they are used under its authority; the government provides employment to every citizen; and the profits obtained from all these factories and businesses go into the government treasury, from where they are used for the benefit of the whole nation.

2. Equal opportunities of progress (Equal Opportunities)

Under socialism every person is provided equal opportunities to progress in life, i.e. every young person, according to his mental inclination and natural tendencies, is provided full facilities of education and training, so that, taking full benefit from his latent abilities and mental capacities, he can adopt whatever profession he wants according to his liking and taste.

اس نظام کے تحت بے شمار تاجر اپنے طور اشیاء پیدا کرنے کا فیصلہ کرتے ہیں، لہٰذا پیدائشِ اشیاء کا کام کسی باقاعدہ منصوبے کے تحت عمل میں نہیں آتا، جس کا نتیجہ یہ ہوتا ہے کہ بعض اوقات پیداوار لوگوں کی مجموعی قوتِ خرید یا طلب سے بڑھ جاتی ہے، اور اسٹاک بن بکے (Unsold) پڑے رہتے ہیں۔ چنانچہ قیمتیں گر جاتی ہیں، ”بے روزگاری“ پھیلنے لگتی ہے اور معیشت بحران (Crisis) اور ”سرد بازاری“ کا شکار ہو جاتی ہے۔

اشتراکی نظام (Socialism)

سوشلزم (اشتراکیت) کی تعریف (Definition) یوں کی گئی ہے:

”اس سے مراد ایسی تحریک ہے جس کا مقصد ہے تمام قدرت ساز آدم ساز اشیائے سرمایہ (جو بڑے پیمانے پر چیزیں پیدا کرنے کے لئے استعمال ہوتی ہیں) کی ملکیت اور انتظام، افراد کی بجائے اجتماعی طور پر قوم کی تحویل میں دی جائیں، تاکہ بڑھتی ہوئی قومی آمدنی، مساویانہ طور پر تقسیم کی جا سکے، لیکن اس سلسلے میں فرد کے معاشی محرک یا اس کی پیشہ ورانہ آزادی اور اشیائے صرف کرنے کے سلسلے میں انتخاب و پسند پر کوئی ضرب نہ لگے۔“

ایک اور ماہرِ معاشیات لکھتے ہیں کہ سوشلزم کے لوازمات میں یہ شامل ہے کہ تمام بڑی بڑی صنعتیں اور اراضی سرکاری یا اجتماعی ملکیت میں ہو اور انہیں شخصی طور پر منافع حاصل کرنے کی بجائے مشترکہ مفاد و بہبود کے لئے استعمال کیا جائے (اور یہ کام ایک قومی سطح کے منصوبے کے عین مطابق انجام دیا جائے) اسے مرکزی منضبط معیشت (Centrally Controlled Economy) بھی کہا جاتا ہے۔

اشتراکی نظامِ معیشت کی نمایاں خصوصیات حسبِ ذیل ہیں:

1۔ پیداواری ذرائع، اجتماعی ملکیت میں:

اس نظام کے تحت بڑے بڑے پیداواری ذرائع اور آلاتِ پیدائش مثلاً کارخانے، صنعتیں، کاروبار، ریلیں اور دیگر معاشی وسائل وغیرہ نجی ملکیت سے نکال کر قومی تحویل میں لے لئے جاتے ہیں، گویا حکومت ہی ان کی مالک ہوتی ہے، اسی کے زیرِ اختیار یہ استعمال کیے جاتے ہیں، حکومت ہر شہری کو روزگار مہیا کرتی ہے اور ان تمام کارخانوں اور کاروباروں سے حاصل ہونے والے منافع جات سرکاری خزانے میں جاتے ہیں جہاں سے وہ پوری قوم کے فائدے کے لئے استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

2۔ ترقی کے یکساں مواقع (Equal Opportunities):

سوشلزم کے تحت ہر شخص کو زندگی میں ترقی کرنے کے یکساں مواقع مہیا کئے جاتے ہیں، یعنی ہر نوجوان کو اپنے ذہنی رجحان اور طبعی میلان کے مطابق، تعلیم و تربیت کی پوری سہولتیں مہیا کی جاتی ہیں، تاکہ وہ اپنی خفتہ صلاحیتوں اور ذہنی اہلیتوں سے پورا پورا فائدہ اٹھا کر، اپنی پسند اور ذوق کے مطابق جو پیشہ چاہے اختیار کر لے۔

3۔ معاشی ترقی (Economic Growth):

سوشلزم کے تحت معاشی ترقی کی رفتار تیز ہو جاتی ہے، کیونکہ وسائلِ پیدائش سرکاری تحویل میں ہونے کے باعث، موثر منصوبہ بندی … (ص 287 پر جاری)

sections.title: باب 13 — متن (15)

paras.text: (continued from p.286) … becomes possible; all productive resources are used in the best and most fruitful way.
paras.urdu: (ص 286 سے جاری) … ممکن ہو جاتی ہے، تمام پیداواری ذرائع کو بہترین اور بار آور طریقے سے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔
paras.pashto: (له ۲۸۶ مخ دوام) … ممکنه کېږي؛ ټولې تولیدي سرچینې په غوره او ګټوره طریقه کارول کېږي.

paras.text: 4. Guarantee of social security (Social Security)
paras.urdu: 4۔ معاشرتی تحفظ (Social Security) کی ضمانت:
paras.pashto: ۴. د ټولنیز خوندیتوب (Social Security) تضمین

paras.text: Under this system, in view of the bitternesses of life, unfavourable conditions and unpleasant accidents, effort is made to provide social security to people, e.g. to save as far as possible from illness, unemployment, disability and accidents, schemes of financial aid are enforced.
paras.urdu: اس نظام کے تحت زندگی کی تلخیوں، نامساعد حالات اور ناگوار حادثات کے پیشِ نظر لوگوں کو معاشرتی تحفظ مہیا کرنے کی کوشش کی جاتی ہے، مثلاً بیماری، بے روزگاری، معذوری اور حادثات سے ممکن حد تک بچاؤ کے لئے مالی امداد کی سکیمیں نافذ کی جاتی ہیں۔
paras.pashto: د دې نظام لاندې د ژوند د تریخوالي، نامناسبو حالاتو او ناوړه پېښو په پام کې نیولو سره خلکو ته د ټولنیز خوندیتوب د برابرولو هڅه کېږي؛ لکه له ناروغۍ، بې‌روزګارۍ، معلولیت او پېښو څخه د امکان تر حده د ژغورنې لپاره د مالي مرستې طرحې پلې کېږي.

paras.text: In the view of the opponents of socialism the following defects are found in this system:
paras.urdu: سوشلزم کے مخالفین کے نزدیک اس نظام میں مندرجہ ذیل خرابیاں پائی جاتی ہیں:
paras.pashto: د سوسیالیزم د مخالفینو په نزد په دې نظام کې لاندې نیمګړتیاوې موندل کېږي:

paras.text: 1. Ending of economic freedom
paras.urdu: 1۔ معاشی آزادی کا خاتمہ:
paras.pashto: ۱. د اقتصادي ازادۍ پای

paras.text: Under this system the freedom of property and business ends, and every individual becomes merely an ordinary part of a collective system; a government blow falls on his autonomy and personal individuality. Therefore the personal identity of man ends.
paras.urdu: اس نظام کے تحت جائیداد اور کاروبار کی آزادی ختم ہو جاتی ہے اور ہر فرد ایک اجتماعی نظام کا معمولی سا پرزہ بن کر رہ جاتا ہے، اس کی خود مختاری اور شخصی وحدت پر سرکاری ضرب لگتی ہے۔ اس لئے انسان کا ذاتی تشخص ختم ہو جاتا ہے۔
paras.pashto: د دې نظام لاندې د ملکیت او کاروبار ازادي ختمېږي، او هر کس یوازې د یوه ټولیز نظام یوه عادي پرزه پاتې کېږي؛ د هغه پر خپلواکۍ او شخصي هویت دولتي ګوزار لګېږي. نو د انسان شخصي هویت ختمېږي.

paras.text: 2. Unsuitability of the government for business
paras.urdu: 2۔ کاروبار کے لئے سرکار کی ناموزونیت:
paras.pashto: ۲. د کاروبار لپاره د حکومت ناوړتیا

paras.text: For economic struggle, business and industrial development there is need for courage, boldness, wide experience, the spirit of taking risk, a responsible attitude, constant supervision and managerial abilities. All these qualities exist in private industrialists, traders and business capitalists. In contrast to them, these qualities are not in salaried officers; therefore they cannot carry out commercial and industrial activities correctly.
paras.urdu: معاشی جدوجہد، کاروبار اور صنعتی ترقی کے لئے جرأت، دلیری، وسیع تجربہ، خطرہ مول لینے کا جذبہ، ذمہ دارانہ رویہ، ہمہ وقت نگرانی اور مدبرانہ صلاحیتوں کی ضرورت ہوتی ہے۔ یہ تمام خوبیاں نجی طور پر صنعت کاروں، تاجروں اور کاروباری سرمایہ داروں میں ہوتی ہیں۔ ان کے برعکس تنخواہ دار افسروں میں یہ خوبیاں نہیں ہوتیں، اس لئے وہ تجارتی اور صنعتی سرگرمیاں صحیح انداز سے سرانجام نہیں دے سکتے۔
paras.pashto: د اقتصادي هڅې، کاروبار او صنعتي پرمختګ لپاره زړورتیا، جرأت، پراخې تجربې، د خطر منلو جذبې، مسؤلانه چلند، تلپاتې څارنې او تدبیري وړتیاوو ته اړتیا وي. دا ټولې ښېګڼې په شخصي ډول په صنعتکارانو، سوداګرو او سوداګریزو پانګوالو کې وي. برعکس، په معاش‌خوړونکو افسرانو کې دا ښېګڼې نه وي؛ نو هغوی سوداګریز او صنعتي فعالیتونه په سمه توګه نشي ترسره کولی.

paras.text: 3. The allocation of resources is not correct
paras.urdu: 3۔ ذرائع کی تخصیص صحیح نہیں ہوتی:
paras.pashto: ۳. د سرچینو تخصیص سم نه وي

paras.text: Under socialism the work of using national productive resources for different purposes is done by a central authority, whereas under the capitalist system this work is settled by the likes and dislikes of consumers, the mechanism of prices and the motive of profit. Therefore all human and material factors of production are used in their best use: how many labourers are where and how much capital is to be used in what work — its decision is made automatically by the free forces of supply and demand. Whereas for some one authority or ruler it is not possible to make a most correct plan, down to details, for the best use of resources. Therefore under socialism the work of the allocation (Allocation) of resources does not take place in the best way.
paras.urdu: سوشلزم کے تحت قومی ذرائع پیداوار کو مختلف مقاصد کے لئے استعمال کرنے کا کام ایک مرکزی اتھارٹی کرتی ہے جبکہ سرمایہ داری نظام کے تحت یہ کام صارفین کی پسند و ناپسند، قیمتوں کی میکانیت، اور محرکِ نفع سے طے پاتا ہے۔ لہٰذا تمام انسانی اور مادی ذرائع پیدائش اپنے بہترین مصرف میں استعمال ہوتے ہیں، کتنے مزدور کہاں کہاں اور کتنا سرمایہ کس کس کام میں استعمال ہونا چاہئے کا فیصلہ خود بخود رسد و طلب کی آزادانہ کارفرما قوتوں سے ہو جاتا ہے، جب کہ کسی ایک اتھارٹی یا مقتدرہ کے لئے یہ ممکن نہیں ہوتا کہ وسائل کے بہترین مصرف کے لئے جزئیاتی حد تک ایک صحیح ترین منصوبہ بنا سکے۔ لہٰذا سوشلزم کے تحت ذرائع کی تخصیص (Allocation) کا کام احسن طریقہ سے نہیں ہو پاتا۔
paras.pashto: د سوسیالیزم لاندې د ملي تولیدي سرچینو د بېلابېلو موخو لپاره د کارولو کار یوه مرکزي اداره کوي، حال دا چې د پانګوالۍ نظام لاندې دا کار د مصرفوونکو د خوښې او ناخوښۍ، د بیو مېکانیزم او د ګټې انګېزې له لارې ټاکل کېږي. نو ټولې بشري او مادي تولیدي سرچینې په خپل غوره مصرف کې کارول کېږي؛ څومره کارګران چېرته او څومره پانګه په کوم کار کې وکارول شي، پرېکړه یې په خپله د عرضې او غوښتنې د ازادو فعالو ځواکونو له لارې کېږي. حال دا چې د یوې ادارې یا واک لپاره دا ممکنه نه ده چې د سرچینو د غوره مصرف لپاره تر جزئیاتو پورې یو تر ټولو سم پلان جوړ کړي. نو د سوسیالیزم لاندې د سرچینو د تخصیص (Allocation) کار په غوره طریقه نه کېږي.

paras.text: In the previous pages first the Islamic economic system and then the characteristics of the capitalist and socialist economic systems have been mentioned in detail. The truth is that apart from the Islamic economic system, the other systems are failing to fulfil the economic needs of man correctly and completely, whereas the Islamic system is exactly natural, and besides fulfilling the needs of man in a satisfying way it possesses many merits, as has been stated in the previous chapter. Here we, first comparing the Islamic economic system with the capitalist system and after it the Islamic economic system with socialism, prove that the Islamic economic system alone is the best system.
paras.urdu: گزشتہ صفحات میں پہلے اسلام معاشی نظام اور پھر سرمایہ داری اور اشتراکی نظامِ معیشت کی خصوصیات کا بالتفصیل ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔ حقیقت یہ ہے کہ اسلامی نظامِ معیشت کے سوا باقی نظام انسان کی معاشی ضروریات کو صحیح اور مکمل طور پر پوری کرنے میں ناکام رہے ہیں جبکہ اسلامی نظام عین فطری ہے۔ اور انسان کی ضروریات کو اطمینان بخش طریقے سے پوری کرنے کے علاوہ بہت سی خوبیوں کا حامل ہے جیسا کہ پچھلے باب میں بیان کیا جا چکا ہے۔ یہاں ہم پہلے اسلامی معاشی نظام اور سرمایہ داری نظام کا موازنہ اور اس کے بعد اسلامی معاشی نظام اور اشتراکیت کا موازنہ کر کے ثابت کرتے ہیں کہ اسلامی معاشی نظام ہی بہترین نظام ہے۔
paras.pashto: په تېرو مخونو کې لومړی اسلامي اقتصادي نظام او بیا د پانګوالۍ او سوسیالیستي اقتصادي نظامونو ځانګړتیاوې په تفصیل یادې شوې. حقیقت دا دی چې له اسلامي اقتصادي نظام پرته نور نظامونه د انسان اقتصادي اړتیاوې په سمه او بشپړه توګه په پوره کولو کې ناکام پاتې شوي، حال دا چې اسلامي نظام بشپړ فطري دی، او د انسان د اړتیاوو په ډاډمنه توګه د پوره کولو سربېره ډېرې ښېګڼې لري، لکه څنګه چې په تېر څپرکي کې بیان شول. دلته موږ لومړی د اسلامي اقتصادي نظام او د پانګوالۍ نظام پرتله او له هغې وروسته د اسلامي اقتصادي نظام او سوسیالیزم پرتله کوو او ثابتوو چې یوازې اسلامي اقتصادي نظام غوره نظام دی.

paras.text: Comparison of the Islamic economic system and the capitalist system
paras.urdu: اسلامی معاشی نظام اور سرمایہ داری نظام کا موازنہ:
paras.pashto: د اسلامي اقتصادي نظام او د پانګوالۍ نظام پرتله

paras.text: Below a comparison of both systems has been made:
paras.urdu: ذیل میں دونوں نظامات کا موازنہ کیا گیا ہے:
paras.pashto: لاندې د دواړو نظامونو پرتله شوې:

paras.text: 1. Observance of Shariah limits
paras.urdu: 1۔ شرعی حدود کی پابندی:
paras.pashto: ۱. د شرعي حدودو پابندي

paras.text: In the Islamic economic system, in connection with earning and spending wealth, the pure teachings of Islam and the Shariah limits and restrictions are kept in view; distinction is made between halal and haram; permissible and impermissible are respected. 4. Guarantee of social security (Social Security)

Under this system, in view of the bitternesses of life, unfavourable conditions and unpleasant accidents, effort is made to provide social security to people, e.g. to save as far as possible from illness, unemployment, disability and accidents, schemes of financial aid are enforced.

In the view of the opponents of socialism the following defects are found in this system:

1. Ending of economic freedom

Under this system the freedom of property and business ends, and every individual becomes merely an ordinary part of a collective system; a government blow falls on his autonomy and personal individuality. Therefore the personal identity of man ends.

2. Unsuitability of the government for business

For economic struggle, business and industrial development there is need for courage, boldness, wide experience, the spirit of taking risk, a responsible attitude, constant supervision and managerial abilities. All these qualities exist in private industrialists, traders and business capitalists. In contrast to them, these qualities are not in salaried officers; therefore they cannot carry out commercial and industrial activities correctly.

3. The allocation of resources is not correct

Under socialism the work of using national productive resources for different purposes is done by a central authority, whereas under the capitalist system this work is settled by the likes and dislikes of consumers, the mechanism of prices and the motive of profit. Therefore all human and material factors of production are used in their best use: how many labourers are where and how much capital is to be used in what work — its decision is made automatically by the free forces of supply and demand. Whereas for some one authority or ruler it is not possible to make a most correct plan, down to details, for the best use of resources. Therefore under socialism the work of the allocation (Allocation) of resources does not take place in the best way.

In the previous pages first the Islamic economic system and then the characteristics of the capitalist and socialist economic systems have been mentioned in detail. The truth is that apart from the Islamic economic system, the other systems are failing to fulfil the economic needs of man correctly and completely, whereas the Islamic system is exactly natural, and besides fulfilling the needs of man in a satisfying way it possesses many merits, as has been stated in the previous chapter. Here we, first comparing the Islamic economic system with the capitalist system and after it the Islamic economic system with socialism, prove that the Islamic economic system alone is the best system.

4. Guarantee of social security (Social Security)

Under this system, in view of the bitternesses of life, unfavourable conditions and unpleasant accidents, effort is made to provide social security to people, e.g. to save as far as possible from illness, unemployment, disability and accidents, schemes of financial aid are enforced.

In the view of the opponents of socialism the following defects are found in this system:

1. Ending of economic freedom

Under this system the freedom of property and business ends, and every individual becomes merely an ordinary part of a collective system; a government blow falls on his autonomy and personal individuality. Therefore the personal identity of man ends.

2. Unsuitability of the government for business

For economic struggle, business and industrial development there is need for courage, boldness, wide experience, the spirit of taking risk, a responsible attitude, constant supervision and managerial abilities. All these qualities exist in private industrialists, traders and business capitalists. In contrast to them, these qualities are not in salaried officers; therefore they cannot carry out commercial and industrial activities correctly.

3. The allocation of resources is not correct

Under socialism the work of using national productive resources for different purposes is done by a central authority, whereas under the capitalist system this work is settled by the likes and dislikes of consumers, the mechanism of prices and the motive of profit. Therefore all human and material factors of production are used in their best use: how many labourers are where and how much capital is to be used in what work — its decision is made automatically by the free forces of supply and demand. Whereas for some one authority or ruler it is not possible to make a most correct plan, down to details, for the best use of resources. Therefore under socialism the work of the allocation (Allocation) of resources does not take place in the best way.

In the previous pages first the Islamic economic system and then the characteristics of the capitalist and socialist economic systems have been mentioned in detail. The truth is that apart from the Islamic economic system, the other systems are failing to fulfil the economic needs of man correctly and completely, whereas the Islamic system is exactly natural, and besides fulfilling the needs of man in a satisfying way it possesses many merits, as has been stated in the previous chapter. Here we, first comparing the Islamic economic system with the capitalist system and after it the Islamic economic system with socialism, prove that the Islamic economic system alone is the best system.

Comparison of the Islamic economic system and the capitalist system

Below a comparison of both systems has been made:

1. Observance of Shariah limits

In the Islamic economic system, in connection with earning and spending wealth, the pure teachings of Islam and the Shariah limits and restrictions are kept in view; distinction is made between halal and haram; permissible and impermissible are respected. Wealth can neither be earned from those works and pursuits which Islam has declared haram, nor can it be spent on haram works, as has been stated in the previous pages; whereas in the capitalist system, staying within the law, income can be earned from all such pursuits and activities (Activities) as are, from the moral point of view, impermissible and detestable, but … (continued on p.288)
